# Bulk–scRNA Concordance

Compare bulk RNA-seq expression with group-level pseudo-bulk profiles from
single-cell RNA-seq. Avai

lable as a DSH Host plugin, Python CLI and MCP server
for Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients.

The tool reports Pearson and Spearman correlations, a linear regression,
optional group-matching dia

gnostics, and figures. Each run records parameters,
input/output hashes and package versions.
## Inputs and analysis

- Single-cell raw counts: `.h5ad`, or a genes × cells CSV with cell metadata.
- Bulk expression: a g

enes × samples CSV/TSV.
- A group label for each cell; bulk sample names must contain the matching
g
roup as an exact delimited token.

Cells are summed by group, and bulk samples are averaged within each group.
The default normalizatio

n is CPM followed by `log2(x+1)`. The regression and
figure use bulk as x and pseudo-bulk as y, with
the same genes and transformations.

For `.h5ad`, the default count source is `layers['counts']` when available,
otherwise `X`. Select a

layer with `--sc-layer <name>` or explicitly select
`raw.X` with `--sc-use-raw`. Gene metadata follo

ws the selected matrix.
All single-cell inputs must contain raw counts: nonfinite, negative and
non-

integer values are rejected. These checks cannot prove that integer-valued
data are untransformed; c
onfirm the source before running.

This is a descriptive comparison. Pooling by group does not estimate biological
replicate variation.

The optional matched–mismatched correlation gap can flag
unexpected matches, but does not prove bio

hed–mismatched correlation gap can flag
unexpected matches, but does not prove biological agreement.
See docs/usage.md for parameters, normalization and limitations.

## Real-data example: human iPSC (GSE77288)

This example compares independently measured bulk and single-cell read counts
from three donors in T

ung et al. (2017),
available as GSE77288.
It uses the authors' 564 QC-passing cells and eight matchi

ng bulk libraries.
The QC list excludes all NA19098.r2 cells, so that batch's bulk library is also
e

xcluded. Both inputs use untransformed read counts; the 92 ERCC spike-in
columns are removed.

| Donor | Cells | Bulk libraries | Genes used | Pearson r | Spearman ρ |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|--

The figure uses default shared axes, hexagonal gene-density bins, a logarithmic
gene-count colorbar,

grid lines, regression lines and per-panel statistics.
The reference run used analysis commit
`7478

bde`.
Raw counts and the correlations/regressions were checked independently.

annotations, verifies

fixed SHA-256 hashes, and writes raw-count inputs and
provenance. It reuses verified cached download

s on later runs. The underlying
counts are downloaded from their public sources rather than bundled

here.
See the example notes for filtering, caching and
the reference environment. All three donors a

re iPSCs: these gene-wise
correlations describe expression agreement, not biological replicate infer

ence
or general classification accuracy. Pearson p-values underflow to zero in the
statistics CSV an
d display as `p < 1e-300` in the figure.

## ChatGPT and Claude through MCP
Install the optional MCP dependencies:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The server exposes `bulk_scrna_concordance` through stdio for local clients
such as Claude Desktop a

nd Claude Code. Streamable HTTP is also supported.
ChatGPT can connect through Secure MCP Tunnel or

an operator-deployed HTTPS
endpoint; account and workspace policies apply. See MCP setup
for client
configuration and deployment requirements.

Inputs must exist on the server machine. The server returns statistics and
artifact paths; it does n

ot upload chat attachments or serve file downloads.
The HTTP server has no built-in authentication a

nd binds to loopback by
default. Keep it private, or place it behind an authenticated HTTPS proxy.
## Outputs
Files are written under `--out-dir`:
| File | Contents |
| `<prefix>_results.json` | Parameters, per-group statistics, diagnostics and warnings; CLI requires

`--results-json` |
| `<prefix>_bulk_scrna_correlation_stats.csv` | Per-group statistics |
| `<prefi

x>_discriminability.csv` | Pseudo-bulk × bulk correlation matrix, when requested |
| `<prefix>_bulk_

scrna_correlation.{png,pdf,svg}` | Scatter plots with regression and y=x lines |
| `<prefix>_manifes

t.json` | Code/input/output hashes and recorded environment versions |
| `<prefix>_run.log` | Analys
is log when called through DSH or MCP |
